action.objective: Advance the king to h5, keeping the extra rook and restricting Black's rook while preparing to push passed pawns.
action.rationale: Kh5 is the sole commit-ready move: exact depth-4 score 790, no mate-in-one reply, tactical refutation not_found, checking-chain probe not_found. White is up a rook; Kh5 sidesteps Black's g6 rook pressure and gains space. Black's likely g6g3 is met by c3c4. No risk acceptance needed. Continuing to press the extra material advantage.
